body:
The GitHub repository was renamed from `jonasotoaguilar/herdr-gentle-agents` to `jonasotoaguilar/herdr-gentle-shell`, and the local `origin` already points at the new name.

The rename is deliberately partial. `herdr-gentle-agents` appears in 33 files, but most of those occurrences are contracts rather than names:

- **Repository identity (update):** `package.json` metadata URLs, `README.md` and `DESIGN.md` links and badges, `docs/*.md` links, the repository slug `install.sh` downloads from, and the install command string the plugin version check prints.
- **Contracts (keep byte-identical):** the state directory segment and plugin ids (`STATE_PLUGIN_ID`, `PLUGIN_ID`, `LEGACY_PLUGIN_ID`, `SIDEBAR_STATE_SEGMENT`, `SIDEBAR_LEGACY_PLUGIN_ID`), the managed-block markers `# BEGIN/# END herdr-gentle-agents (managed; do not edit)` already written into the user's Pi settings, state file names, `repo_key` values, the Herdr plugin directory name, and every test that pins them.

Renaming a contract would orphan the installed state on disk and make the tooling stop recognising the managed block it wrote, which is why S15 of `odd/tasks/customize-command.md` forbids it.

Acceptance: the full suite green, and every changed occurrence reported as a URL/identity reference with its reason, alongside every occurrence deliberately kept.
title: chore: update the repository references after the rename to herdr-gentle-shell
